title: XOR Transformations (Easy Version)
statement: Each transformation replaces an array of m integers with its m smallest pairwise XORs. Given n values below 2^30 and q independent queries x, the task is to report max minus min after x transformations. With sums of n and q at most 2000, all pairwise XORs can be listed per step; a pigeonhole argument on the highest differing bit shows the array hits all zeros within about 31 steps.
